session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Sell Climax, Reversal into Bull Channel Then Tight Trading Range'. Big gap-up open at 6907 immediately reversed down (opening reversal in a 3-day trading range), consecutive falling wedges to an exhaustive sell climax of 6854 at 23:25 (bar 12), then 'strong reversal but still in bear channel' turning into a tight bull channel grinding to 6895 by 03:10, finishing in a tight trading range into the close (shaded box, red dotted 6892 resistance). Axis ET+13 hrs (22:00-05:00, Nov 4 marker) - offset suspicion recorded; times as printed. Inset daily panel: 'Trading Range' with Thurs/Fri/Mon labels.
